## Goal

Create and configure the external services production needs, without agents touching live credentials.

## Context

Required vars are listed in `docs/DEPLOYMENT.md`.

## Scope

- Neon production and staging branches.
- R2 media bucket (public CDN domain) and documents bucket (no public access).
- Resend domain verification.
- Turnstile widget, Ecomail list.
- Upstash database.
- Stripe test keys for Phase A.
- Secrets stored in a password manager and on the server only.

## Out of scope

- Live Stripe keys.
- Fakturoid live (Phase B).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Each service checked with a minimal call from staging.
- [ ] Nothing committed to git.

## Required tests

- Staging `/healthz` 200 with production-shaped config.

## Dependencies

- none

## Priority

P0 · Phase A

## Agent

Owner (PM prepares runbook)
